name: texture
title: modelBuild:texture
lead: Makes a pixel picture for one face; with `tint`, drawn in greys and coloured by that material. With `scroll`, it moves by itself on a block drawn from the model, `speed` texels a tick (1, 2, 3, or 0.5, 0.25).
signature: modelBuild:texture(width: number, height: number, opts: { tint: ModelMaterial ?, scroll: ("up" | "down" | "left" | "right")?, speed: number ? }?) → ModelTexture
